svg.text: Prince Rupert's Drop: why the bulb is strong and the tail is fatal
Schematic graphs: physics signs and sequence are real; curve shapes are educational, not measured FEA.
outer shell: compression squeezes cracks shut
inner core: tension stores elastic energy
glass fails when cracks open in tension
surface compression makes the bulb hard to crack
Outside solidifies first. Later the inside wants to shrink,
but the rigid shell prevents free shrinkage.
4. Why the tail is the trigger
